summary: Only one bank cleared the filter this cycle: Goldman Sachs, via GS economics team tweets relayed by @MikeZaccardi. All three items track the same US growth/inflation cycle: Q2 real GDP printed 1.5% annualized (below expectations) but with a strong underlying mix — consumer spending and nonresidential fixed investment both rose sharply; core PCE rose 0.13% m/m (3.29% y/y), with GS expecting inflation to stay benign; and GS launched its Q3 GDP tracker at +2.4%. No other bank/strategist research or Neil Sethi (@neilksethi/@neilksethinew) content appeared in this collection — the remaining 57 tweets in the 4-day window were unmatched-bank price/options-chart noise. Per-bank counts: Goldman 3.
